version.$comment: SemVer, mirrors catalog version at fortune5-bblocks.json:3

name.$comment: Group id, e.g. 'encryption-kms'. MUST NOT equal any ea: element IRI local name (DoD #9 twin; enforce in CI, not schema).

domain.$comment: Deployment-topology domain, orthogonal to the EA class hierarchy.

dependencies.$comment: Edges to sibling f5ea:SolutionGroup individuals — never to SBBs.

references_only.$comment: INVARIANT (hard, not advisory): members of this manifest are references to pre-existing ea: individuals. Any other value is a validation failure, not a configuration choice.

rdf_type_must_not.$comment: Class-assertion guard. If ANY member IRI carries rdf:type in this list — in this manifest OR in the merged EA graph — validation refuses with Refusal::PackConflation semantics (ggen-abb-sbb/src/lib.rs:155). Mirrors DoD #9 / falsifiers.rs:513.

member_packs.$comment: ggen pack identities (manufacturing contracts), never EA individuals.

provider_variants.$comment: Provider projection, identical law to provider_packs (fortune5-bblocks.json:17-21); closed provider universe per bblock.rs:212.

sbb_references.$comment: The ONLY channel through which the deployment layer touches the EA layer.

iri.$comment: Absolute IRI of an EXISTING ea:SolutionBuildingBlock individual.

digest.$comment: Content digest (ea:exactSubject pin) of the referenced SBB at reference time. Drift = dangling reference (Refusal::DanglingReference, ggen-abb-sbb/src/lib.rs:457).

role.$comment: Deployment-topology relation, NOT an EA classification. The group does not BECOME the SBB; it uses it.
